name: pie-chart
title: PieChart
description: Radii and hoverOffset use pixels; angles use radians. Input order is preserved; finite non-negative values determine the total. Invalid slices retain their index without visible geometry. Default hover is translate by 10px, innerRadius=0, padAngle=0 and cornerRadius=0. Geometry scrubbing skips Motion path morphing. Explicitly assign colors when items can reorder. DonutSummary retains its separate total/unassigned semantics.
